name: units_of_measure

columns.name: code
columns.comment: UN/CEFACT common code, such as EA, KGM or CS; the natural key.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Display name, such as each, kilogram or case.

columns.name: dimension
columns.comment: What the unit measures - count, mass, length, volume or area.

columns.name: is_base_unit
columns.comment: Whether the unit is the base of its dimension.

columns.name: decimals_allowed
columns.comment: Decimals allowed on quantities in the unit.

comment: A unit in which goods are counted, weighed or sold, from UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20.
